continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/capabilities/reasoning (read 2026-10-29): `qwen-3.8-27b` returns reasoning "separately in `choices[0].message.reasoning`"; "When you include an earlier assistant message with its `reasoning` field, `clear_thinking` controls whether Qwen receives that historical reasoning" -- `false` or omitted "Preserves historical assistant reasoning. This is the default." The adapter replays it under Cerebras's own field name, `reasoning`. Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
